answer: The violet register is checked at draw time, falcon lists the eligible set, and mesa seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 76 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 76 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 201 account operation therefore ties up 3 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
